inputs.topic: Linh An chạy bộ buổi sáng bên Hồ Tây

prompt:
MANDATORY OUTFIT LOCK: Linh An must wear exactly this athletic sport outfit for the action.
Sport outfit: mint-green Nike racerback loose crop tank top, dual Swoosh logos at collar, perforated ventilation panels on chest and back, mint-green Nike running shorts (3-inch inseam) with mesh waistband and small Swoosh logo on leg, white Nike running shoes, white ankle socks, sleek high ponytail.
Reject any conflicting wardrobe description. No skirt, no dress, no handbag, no knit cardigan, no blouse, no casual city-walk outfit.

MASKED FACE RESTORATION. The supplied action image is the immutable base canvas. The supplied feathered white face mask is the only editable region. Use the single A2-front reference as the sole identity authority. Reconstruct only the face inside the mask with the same exact head position, eye spacing, almond eyes, brows, nose bridge, lips, cheek volume, jawline, chin and natural asymmetry as A2-front. Do not regenerate, reinterpret or change any body, running pose, hair outside the mask, Nike light-blue running outfit, hands, lake, white railing, trees, road, lighting, camera framing or background pixels. Output a photorealistic natural Vietnamese KOL face blended to the existing head and lighting.

Reference mode: masked-edit. Do not use a standing face image as an edit reference; solve the requested full-body pose from text and keep Linh An as the visible physical actor.
